newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Corimon hopes to break even by end 97 fiscal year.
newsitem.headline: Corimon hopes to break even by end 97 fiscal year.

text.p: Leading Venezuelan paints and packaging company Corimon hopes to break even in the current fiscal year which ends March 1997, company president Francisco Layrisse said.
"We hope to break even in March," Layrisse told reporters.
But, "financially we're still house cleaning," he added.

Although the restructuring of over $100 million of debt earlier this year has brought Corimon back from the brink of bankruptcy, the company reported a net loss of 60 billion bolivars ($128 million) for the year ended March 1996.
Second quarter results for the current fiscal year showed a 700 million bolivar profit ($1.48 million), versus a 1.8 billion bolivar profit ($3.8 million) for the same period in the year before.
